subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should trigger selection wait for a structured metadata contract?
rationale: Current source still uses `description` as the prompt-visible selection signal, but public docs emphasize short descriptions and a separate open issue proposes structured trigger metadata, so automation should not choose the authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only pass that keeps descriptions short, trigger-critical, and compatible with current prompt-budget guidance.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact for now and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for exact trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that concise WHAT-style descriptions are intentional and close or redirect related partial PRs accordingly.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only pass that keeps descriptions short, trigger-critical, and compatible with current prompt-budget guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skill-docs and bundled-skill guidance history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the public wording policy.
